title: micromeria cremnophila subsp. amana
intro: Micromeria cremnophila subsp. amana, commonly known as a species of herbaceous plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is a subspecies of Micromeria cremnophila, a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its small, oval-shaped leaves and purple flowers. The health benefits of Micromeria cremnophila subsp. amana include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent, and its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties.
